title: DX12 SM6.6 Bindless Descriptor Heap (Target Architecture)
description: Target architecture for descriptor management: single global CBV_SRV_UAV descriptor heap (1M slots). Resources get persistent descriptor index on creation. Shaders access via ResourceDescriptorHeap[index] — no per-draw descriptor table swaps. This eliminates the biggest DX12 CPU overhead and resolves the current root signature saturation (64/64 DWORDs). Currently blocked behind task 3.41.0 migration.
whenToUse: When migrating from the current root signature model to bindless. When implementing new material/texture features that need more descriptor slots. When designing SM6.6 shader code.
whenNotToUse: On SM5.0 fallback path (no ResourceDescriptorHeap support). For compute-only passes that use separate root signature with sufficient space.
